verses.original: הֲיָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֭ת לֶ֣דֶת יַעֲלֵי־ סָ֑לַע חֹלֵ֖ל אַיָּל֣וֹת תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yā·ḏa‘·tā ‘êṯ le·ḏeṯ ya·‘ă·lê- sā·la‘ ḥō·lêl ’ay·yā·lō·wṯ tiš·mōr
verses.literal: Do you know when mountain goats give birth Have you watched the doe bear her fawn
verses.literalPt: Sabes, porventura, o tempo do parto das cabras monteses? Ou podes observar quando parem as corças?

verses.original: תִּסְפֹּ֣ר יְרָחִ֣ים תְּמַלֶּ֑אנָה וְ֝יָדַ֗עְתָּ עֵ֣ת לִדְתָּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: tis·pōr yə·rā·ḥîm tə·mal·le·nāh wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā ‘êṯ liḏ·tā·nāh
verses.literal: Can you count the months they are pregnant Do you know the time they give birth
verses.literalPt: Podes contar os meses que cumprem? Ou sabes o tempo do seu parto?

verses.original: תִּ֭כְרַעְנָה יַלְדֵיהֶ֣ן תְּפַלַּ֑חְנָה חֶבְלֵיהֶ֥ם תְּשַׁלַּֽחְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: tiḵ·ra‘·nāh yal·ḏê·hen tə·p̄al·laḥ·nāh ḥeḇ·lê·hem tə·šal·laḥ·nāh
verses.literal: They crouch down and bring forth their young they deliver their newborn
verses.literalPt: Encurvam-se, dão à luz as suas crias, lançam de si as suas dores.

verses.original: יַחְלְמ֣וּ בְ֭נֵיהֶם יִרְבּ֣וּ בַבָּ֑ר יָ֝צְא֗וּ וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥בוּ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·lə·mū ḇə·nê·hem yir·bū ḇab·bār yā·ṣə·’ū wə·lō- šā·ḇū lā·mōw
verses.literal: Their young ones thrive and grow up in the open field they leave and do not return
verses.literalPt: Seus filhos são robustos, crescem no campo; saem e não tornam a voltar.

verses.original: מִֽי־ שִׁלַּ֣ח פֶּ֣רֶא חָפְשִׁ֑י וּמֹסְר֥וֹת עָ֝ר֗וֹד מִ֣י פִתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: mî- šil·laḥ pe·re ḥā·p̄ə·šî ū·mō·sə·rō·wṯ ‘ā·rō·wḏ mî p̄it·tê·aḥ
verses.literal: Who set the wild donkey free Who released the swift donkey from the harness
verses.literalPt: Quem enviou livre o asno montês? Ou quem soltou as prisões ao onagro,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי עֲרָבָ֣ה בֵית֑וֹ וּֽמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָ֥יו מְלֵֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- śam·tî ‘ă·rā·ḇāh ḇê·ṯōw ū·miš·kə·nō·w·ṯāw mə·lê·ḥāh
verses.literal: I made the wilderness his home and the salt flats his dwelling
verses.literalPt: ao qual dei, por casa, o deserto e, por morada, a terra salgada?

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂחַק לַהֲמ֣וֹן קִרְיָ֑ה תְּשֻׁא֥וֹת נ֝וֹגֵ֗שׂ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·ḥaq la·hă·mō·wn qir·yāh tə·šu·’ō·wṯ nō·w·ḡêś lō yiš·mā‘
verses.literal: He scorns the tumult of the city and never hears the shouts of a driver
verses.literalPt: Ele despreza o tumulto da cidade e não ouve os gritos do guia.

verses.original: יְת֣וּר הָרִ֣ים מִרְעֵ֑הוּ וְאַחַ֖ר כָּל־ יָר֣וֹק יִדְרֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ṯūr hā·rîm mir·‘ê·hū wə·’a·ḥar kāl- yā·rō·wq yiḏ·rō·wōš
verses.literal: He roams the mountains for pasture searching for any green thing
verses.literalPt: O circuito das montanhas é o seu pasto, e anda buscando tudo o que está verde.

verses.original: הֲיֹ֣אבֶה רֵּ֣ים עָבְדֶ֑ךָ אִם־ יָ֝לִ֗ין עַל־ אֲבוּסֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yō·ḇeh rēm ‘ā·ḇə·ḏe·ḵā ’im- yā·lîn ‘al- ’ă·ḇū·se·ḵā
verses.literal: Will the wild ox consent to serve you . . . Will he stay by your manger at night
verses.literalPt: Acaso, quererá o boi bravio servir-te? Ou ficará ele junto da tua manjedoura?

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽתִקְשָׁר־ רֵ֭ים בְּתֶ֣לֶם עֲבֹת֑וֹ אִם־ יְשַׂדֵּ֖ד עֲמָקִ֣ים אַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hăṯiq·šār- rêm bə·ṯe·lem ‘ă·ḇō·ṯōw ’im- yə·śad·dêḏ ‘ă·mā·qîm ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Can you hold him to the furrow with a harness . . . Will he plow the valleys behind you
verses.literalPt: Porventura, podes prendê-lo ao arado com cordas? Ou estorroará ele os vales após ti?

verses.original: הֲֽתִבְטַח־ בּ֭וֹ כִּי־ רַ֣ב כֹּח֑וֹ וְתַעֲזֹ֖ב אֵלָ֣יו יְגִיעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯiḇ·ṭaḥ- bōw kî- raḇ kō·ḥōw wə·ṯa·‘ă·zōḇ ’ê·lāw yə·ḡî·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: Can you rely on his great strength Will you leave your hard work to him
verses.literalPt: Confiarás nele, por ser grande a sua força? Ou deixarás a seu cargo o teu trabalho?

verses.original: הֲתַאֲמִ֣ין בּ֭וֹ כִּי־ יָשׁוּב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְֽגָרְנְךָ֥ יֶאֱסֹֽף׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯa·’ă·mîn bōw kî- yå̄·šūḇ zar·‘e·ḵā wə·ḡā·rə·nə·ḵā ye·’ĕ·sōp̄
verses.literal: Can you trust him to bring in your grain and gather it to your threshing floor
verses.literalPt: Fiarás dele que colha o que semeaste e ajunte o trigo da tua eira?

verses.original: כְּנַף־ רְנָנִ֥ים נֶעֱלָ֑סָה אִם־ אֶ֝בְרָ֗ה חֲסִידָ֥ה וְנֹצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kə·nap̄- rə·nā·nîm ne·‘ĕ·lā·sāh ’im- ’eḇ·rāh ḥă·sî·ḏāh wə·nō·ṣāh
verses.literal: The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully but cannot match the pinions and feathers of the stork
verses.literalPt: As asas do avestruz se movem de regozijo; porém são benignas as suas asas e penas?

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תַעֲזֹ֣ב לָאָ֣רֶץ בֵּצֶ֑יהָ וְֽעַל־ עָפָ֥ר תְּחַמֵּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯa·‘ă·zōḇ lā·’ā·reṣ bê·ṣe·hā wə·‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār tə·ḥam·mêm
verses.literal: For she leaves her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand
verses.literalPt: Pois ela deixa os seus ovos na terra, os aquenta no pó

verses.original: וַ֭תִּשְׁכַּח כִּי־ רֶ֣גֶל תְּזוּרֶ֑הָ וְחַיַּ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה תְּדוּשֶֽׁהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·kaḥ kî- re·ḡel tə·zū·re·hā wə·ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh tə·ḏū·še·hā
verses.literal: She forgets that a foot may crush them or a wild animal may trample them
verses.literalPt: e se esquece de que o pé os pode pisar ou de que a fera os pode calcar.

verses.original: הִקְשִׁ֣יחַ בָּנֶ֣יהָ לְּלֹא־ לָ֑הּ לְרִ֖יק יְגִיעָ֣הּ בְּלִי־ פָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: hiq·šî·aḥ bā·ne·hā lə·lō- lāh lə·rîq yə·ḡî·‘āh bə·lî- p̄ā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: She treats her young harshly as if not her own with no concern that her labor was in vain
verses.literalPt: Endurece-se contra seus filhos, como se não fossem seus. Embora se perca o seu trabalho, ela não receia,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִשָּׁ֣הּ אֱל֣וֹהַּ חָכְמָ֑ה וְלֹא־ חָ֥לַק לָ֝֗הּ בַּבִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hiš·šāh ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ḥāḵ·māh wə·lō- ḥā·laq lāh bab·bî·nāh
verses.literal: For God has deprived her of wisdom He has not endowed her with understanding
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus lhe negou sabedoria e não lhe deu entendimento.

verses.original: כָּ֭עֵת בַּמָּר֣וֹם תַּמְרִ֑יא תִּֽשְׂחַ֥ק לַ֝סּ֗וּס וּלְרֹֽכְבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kā·‘êṯ bam·mā·rō·wm tam·rî tiś·ḥaq las·sūs ū·lə·rō·ḵə·ḇōw
verses.literal: Yet when she proudly spreads her wings she laughs at the horse and its rider
verses.literalPt: Quando ela se levanta para fuga, zomba do cavalo e do cavaleiro.

verses.original: הֲתִתֵּ֣ן לַסּ֣וּס גְּבוּרָ֑ה הֲתַלְבִּ֖ישׁ צַוָּאר֣וֹ רַעְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯit·tên las·sūs gə·ḇū·rāh hă·ṯal·bîš ṣaw·wā·rōw ra‘·māh
verses.literal: Do you give strength to the horse or adorn his neck with a mane
verses.literalPt: Acaso, deste ao cavalo a sua força? Ou vestiste o seu pescoço com crinas flutuantes?

verses.original: הְֽ֭תַרְעִישֶׁנּוּ כָּאַרְבֶּ֑ה ה֖וֹד נַחְר֣וֹ אֵימָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hə·ṯar·‘î·šen·nū kā·’ar·beh hō·wḏ naḥ·rōw ’ê·māh
verses.literal: Do you make him leap like a locust striking terror with his proud snorting
verses.literalPt: Fizeste-o pular como o gafanhoto? Terrível é o fogoso respirar das suas ventas.

verses.original: יַחְפְּר֣וּ בָ֭עֵמֶק וְיָשִׂ֣ישׂ בְּכֹ֑חַ יֵ֝צֵ֗א לִקְרַאת־ נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·pə·rū ḇā·‘ê·meq wə·yā·śîś bə·ḵō·aḥ yê·ṣê liq·raṯ- nā·šeq
verses.literal: He paws in the valley and rejoices in his strength he charges . . . into battle
verses.literalPt: Escarva no vale e regozija-se na sua força; sai ao encontro dos armados.

verses.original: יִשְׂחַ֣ק לְ֭פַחַד וְלֹ֣א יֵחָ֑ת וְלֹֽא־ יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִפְּנֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·ḥaq lə·p̄a·ḥaḏ wə·lō yê·ḥāṯ wə·lō- yā·šūḇ mip·pə·nê- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: He laughs at fear frightened of nothing he does not turn back from the sword
verses.literalPt: Zomba do medo, e não se espanta, e não se desvia da espada.

verses.original: עָ֭לָיו תִּרְנֶ֣ה אַשְׁפָּ֑ה לַ֖הַב חֲנִ֣ית וְכִידֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·lāw tir·neh ’aš·pāh la·haḇ ḥă·nîṯ wə·ḵî·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: A quiver rattles at his side along with a flashing spear and lance
verses.literalPt: Sobre ele rangem a aljava, a lança cintilante e o dardo.

verses.original: בְּרַ֣עַשׁ וְ֭רֹגֶז יְגַמֶּא־ אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹֽא־ יַ֝אֲמִ֗ין כִּי־ ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ra·‘aš wə·rō·ḡez yə·ḡam·me- ’ā·reṣ wə·lō- ya·’ă·mîn kî- qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār
verses.literal: Trembling with excitement he devours the distance he cannot stand still . . . when the ram’s horn sounds
verses.literalPt: De fúria e ira devora a terra e não se contém ao som da trombeta.

verses.original: בְּדֵ֤י שֹׁפָ֨ר׀ יֹ֘אמַ֤ר הֶאָ֗ח וּֽ֭מֵרָחוֹק יָרִ֣יחַ מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥עַם שָׂ֝רִים וּתְרוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḏê šō·p̄ār yō·mar he·’āḥ ū·mê·rā·ḥō·wq yā·rî·aḥ mil·ḥā·māh ra·‘am śā·rîm ū·ṯə·rū·‘āh
verses.literal: At the blast of the horn he snorts with fervor He catches the scent of battle from afar the shouts of captains and the cry of war
verses.literalPt: Toda vez que soa a trombeta, diz: Eia! Cheira de longe a batalha, o trovão dos capitães e os gritos.

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽ֭מִבִּינָ֣תְךָ יַֽאֲבֶר־ נֵ֑ץ יִפְרֹ֖שׂ כְּנָפוֹ לְתֵימָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: hămib·bî·nā·ṯə·ḵā ya·’ă·ḇer- nêṣ yip̄·rōś kə·nå̄·p̄ō lə·ṯê·mān
verses.literal: Does the hawk take flight by your understanding and spread his wings toward the south
verses.literalPt: Acaso, se eleva o falcão pela tua sabedoria e estende as suas asas para o Sul?

verses.original: אִם־ עַל־ פִּ֭יךָ יַגְבִּ֣יהַּ נָ֑שֶׁר וְ֝כִ֗י יָרִ֥ים קִנּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ‘al- pî·ḵā yaḡ·bî·ah nā·šer wə·ḵî yā·rîm qin·nōw
verses.literal: Does the eagle . . . soar at your command and make his nest on high
verses.literalPt: Porventura, se remonta a águia ao teu mandado e põe no alto o seu ninho?

verses.original: סֶ֣לַע יִ֭שְׁכֹּן וְיִתְלֹנָ֑ן עַֽל־ שֶׁן־ סֶ֝֗לַע וּמְצוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: se·la‘ yiš·kōn wə·yiṯ·lō·nān ‘al- šen- se·la‘ ū·mə·ṣū·ḏāh
verses.literal: He dwells on a cliff and lodges there his stronghold is on a rocky crag
verses.literalPt: No penhasco mora e ali tem a sua pousada, sobre o cume do penhasco e sobre o lugar seguro.

verses.original: מִשָּׁ֥ם חָֽפַר־ אֹ֑כֶל לְ֝מֵרָח֗וֹק עֵינָ֥יו יַבִּֽיטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šām ḥā·p̄ar- ’ō·ḵel lə·mê·rā·ḥō·wq ‘ê·nāw yab·bî·ṭū
verses.literal: From there he spies out food his eyes see it from afar
verses.literalPt: Dali, espia a presa, os seus olhos a avistam de longe.

verses.original: וְאֶפְרֹחוֹ יְעַלְעוּ־ דָ֑ם וּבַאֲשֶׁ֥ר חֲ֝לָלִ֗ים שָׁ֣ם הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾɛp̄·rō·ḥō yə·‘al·‘ū- ḏām ū·ḇa·’ă·šer ḥă·lā·lîm šām hū
verses.literal: His young ones feast on blood and where the slain are there he is
verses.literalPt: Seus filhos chupam sangue. Onde há mortos, ali está ela.
